title: feat(research): share the rank-seven restore covector
body:
## Summary

R2 shares the current-register covector `X40 - 2 X54` across two separated restore consumers on PR2979's words, then restores both dirty sources. It composes with Jeremy Kothe's R1 from #3015.

```diff
 R1 local profile
- {1:2443, 2:707, 3:232, 4:108, 5:18, 8:8}
+ {1:2441, 2:708, 3:232, 4:108, 5:18, 8:8}
```

The per-call delta is `H2 - 2H1 < 0` for every positive saving. The literal T74 allocation, all ordered widths, 91 private buffers and scalar gate counts are unchanged.

[Proof, sources, full invoice and reproduction](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1f922b25abff2d7fd87fa5b29619160862a06b59/research/rank7-shared-restore-fanin/README.md). [Canonical investigation and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18981612).

## Evidence

- **Before:** #3030's released T740+R1 nomination is `0.001729152756004330934535 - 10^-46 - 10^-70`.
  **After:** a fresh complete T74 source/native/admission/modern-outer release certifies `0.001729267980311944693216 - 10^-46 - 10^-70`. Exact gain `115224307613758681/10^24`.
- Separate 704-column rational restore equality and four-register set-span census; both providers pass 632-input forward/dual audits. Sixteen rejecting word/contract controls and ten behavioral groups pass.
- Fresh retained bootstrap and both fresh native providers; thirteen stages total 1,272.70 seconds locally. The emitted invoice charges 66,813 physical families, all 666 invocation/bridge sweeps, and prefix 1,475 within payload 2,048.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, optimized replay, Python 3.13 finite replay, ten receipt/invoice mutants, strict lint, compilation and all 53 committed package/input-byte comparisons pass. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-shared-restore-fanin
```

Credit Jeremy Kothe for R1 and the literal edit tooling, Marius-Paul Dumitrean for PR2979, and the retained geometry/native/owner lineage. Original notices remain. New R2 and this composition are by Nick Petalas.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only a new research package and its opt-in replay are added. Frozen predecessors and the selected frontier are unchanged. This is an author-checked conditional finite candidate, not scientific adoption or a complete multiplication theorem. Inherited all-size/compiler, physical, precision/tape, caller, analytic and universal block-energy hypotheses remain. Independent review/replay and a separately bound T740+R2 composition are open next questions.
